ctx.x: Yeah, well, I played that with Buck. And they had the, at that time, they had the Tulane Brass Band. Well, Tulane, I used to work with them on sax, and John was playing with them on clarinet. That was drummed by Al Landry, Tulane Band. Well, John said if we could make a name for the Tulane Band, why not let's go and pull off and make up a band of ours own. And that's why we organized at the Young Tuxedo, because we pulled out from the Tulane, you see, and John made up his own band.
What year were you playing with the Tulane Band, Wilbur?
